summary: Advisory domain: suggestion ranking/explanation, Mentor routing/voice/memory, Mentor Survey V2 and the canonical ArchetypeRegistry. Survey V2 conforms to its approved contract (draft-only state, single atomic ledger writer via the progression finalizer, inert tag boundary). The legacy suggestion stack does not: suggestion analytics are persisted by four independent writers directly to actor flags (one with an invalid flag scope), the read path getSuggestions writes up to eight flags per call, Mentor commitment decay runs on every client from an updateActor hook, and SuggestionEngineCoordinator.initialize() is never invoked so its hooks, game.swse.suggestions and the anchor/pivot pipeline never start. Ability-modifier reading is reimplemented in at least seven modules. 69 modules (~10.7k SLOC) are unreachable in seven clusters, almost all legacy class C. No actor game state (items, system fields, credits) is mutated by live MEN code; writes are advisory flags only.

findings.title: Advisory analytics and Mentor memory written directly to actor flags
findings.observed: Probe reported 24 sites. 8 are false positives (ReasonFactory.create in SuggestionExplainer.js:308/326/334, SuggestionReasonEngine.js:49/257/630, ClassDomainReasonEngine.js:295, attribute-planner.js:158). 16 are real actor setFlag/unsetFlag writes of advisory metadata (no items, system fields or credits). 15 carry '@mutation-exception: metadata'; SuggestionService.js:621 has none (wrapped in ShellMutationGuard instead). ActorEngine.updateActorFlags exists but forces recalcAll, which is a plausible reason for the bypass. Runtime-executed today: SelectionRecorder, SuggestionService._setSuggestionState, mentor-memory. Not executed: SuggestionStateService/AnchorRepository (F-MEN-002), WishlistEngine (only orphan wishlist-ui), mentor-dialogues setters (F-MEN-012).
findings.intendedOwnership: ActorEngine owns actor mutation (A-02/OSI); one suggestion-state service owns advisory flags.
findings.proposedSolution: Owner decides whether advisory metadata flags are a documented A-02 exception class. If yes: record it in A-02 / repo-structure.md and route all MEN flag writes through one SuggestionStateService. If no: add an ActorEngine flag path that skips recalcAll for declared non-derived metadata keys and route through it.
findings.alternatives: Move suggestion analytics off the actor entirely (client-local or user flags) since it is per-player UI history.
findings.regressionTests: Source test: no actor.setFlag/unsetFlag in scripts/engine/suggestion or scripts/engine/mentor outside the chosen service.
findings.foundryAcceptance: Level up and open Mentor chat; verify flags written once and no recalculation storm.
findings.simplificationBenefit: One persistence owner instead of four.

findings.title: SuggestionEngineCoordinator.initialize() is never called
findings.observed: No runtime module (static, dynamic, index, hooks) calls SuggestionEngineCoordinator.initialize(). Consequently game.swse.suggestions is never assigned, SuggestionEngineHooks never registers its 5 listeners (4 of which also have no emitter anywhere), and the BuildIdentityAnchor/PivotDetector/SuggestionStateService post-level-up pipeline never runs. The census labels these modules reachable-static because they are imported, not executed.
findings.intendedOwnership: Coordinator documented as 'Called during system ready hook' (SuggestionEngineCoordinator.js:66).
findings.proposedSolution: Owner chooses: (a) wire initialize() once at ready (after fixing F-MEN-003/F-MEN-004-style multi-client guards) or (b) declare the anchor/pivot/hook pipeline retired, remove SuggestionEngineHooks/PivotStateManager/AnchorRepository writers and the game.swse.suggestions debug path.
findings.alternatives: Keep dormant and document as UNIMPLEMENTED.
findings.regressionTests: Test that asserts initialize() is reachable from the ready hook, or a source guard that the retired modules are gone.
findings.foundryAcceptance: After choice (a): check game.swse.suggestions exists at ready and level-up writes one anchor/pivot state.
findings.simplificationBenefit: Removes an inert ~1k SLOC execution path or makes it real.
findings.risk: Enabling it activates untested writers on every level-up.

findings.title: SuggestionStateService uses flag scope 'swse' instead of the system id
findings.observed: NS = 'swse' while system.json id is 'foundryvtt-swse'. Foundry validates flag scopes against the system id and active modules, so getFlag/setFlag('swse', ...) is expected to throw (caught and logged in the writers; getState at :155 is not wrapped). Same scope used by unreachable ArchetypeAffinityEngine ('flags.swse.archetypeAffinity'). Currently masked by F-MEN-002.
findings.proposedSolution: Technical defect fix: use the system id constant. Do before enabling F-MEN-002 option (a).
findings.alternatives: Delete the service if F-MEN-002 option (b) is chosen.
findings.regressionTests: Unit test asserting SuggestionStateService scope equals system id.
findings.foundryAcceptance: FOUNDRY_ACCEPTANCE_REQUIRED: confirm the scope error in a live client before/after.

findings.title: Mentor commitment decay runs on every client from an updateActor hook
findings.observed: The 'swse-mentor-decay' updateActor listener ignores userId, so every connected client that has previously observed the actor's level calls decayAllMentorCommitments, which setFlags the actor. Owners (GM + player) each apply the 15% decay (compounded); non-owners attempt a write they lack permission for. The per-client _actorLevelMap means the result depends on which clients were connected.
findings.intendedOwnership: Exactly one client (the originating user, or the active GM) performs advisory follow-up writes.
findings.proposedSolution: Guard with userId === game.user.id (or single active GM); better, perform decay inside the level-up finalization path (swse:level-up-complete is emitted locally by the finalizer) rather than an updateActor observer.
findings.alternatives: Compute decay lazily on read from stored levels instead of persisting decayed values.
findings.regressionTests: Hook test simulating two clients; assert one write.
findings.foundryAcceptance: Two connected owners, level up once, check commitment value decayed once.

findings.title: Ability modifier and skill reading reimplemented across suggestion modules
findings.observed: Canonical SchemaAdapters.getAbilityMod exists. Suggestion modules each read different paths (system.attributes.<k>.mod, system.abilities.<k>.mod, total/value/score fallbacks) and recompute floor((score-10)/2) locally; shared-suggestion-utilities already uses SchemaAdapters for scores but recomputes the modifier, ignoring derived modifiers. Different fallback orders can give different advisory results for the same actor. The formula itself is standard; this is a schema-interpretation duplicate, not a rules question.
findings.proposedSolution: Replace every local reader with SchemaAdapters.getAbilityMod/getAbilityScore; make extractAbilityModifiers delegate.
findings.alternatives: One suggestion-local adapter that delegates to SchemaAdapters.
findings.regressionTests: Extend tests/consumer-batch-ability-authority.test.mjs with a source guard forbidding '(score - 10) / 2' in scripts/engine/suggestion.
findings.risk: Advisory rankings may shift slightly where fallbacks differed.

findings.title: getSuggestions (read path) performs sequential actor flag writes
findings.observed: On a cache miss in levelup/chargen/mentor/decision-step contexts, _recordSuggestionsShown loops over up to 8 suggestions and each SelectionRecorder.recordSuggestionShown awaits a separate actor.setFlag (each a server round-trip plus updateActor broadcast and sheet re-render). It also runs during chargen/level-up before finalization, contrary to OSI 'temporary choices live in session/draft state'.
findings.intendedOwnership: Evaluation is pure (ENGINE-ARCH §10); analytics persisted once, outside the read path.
findings.proposedSolution: Hypothesis to confirm with instrumentation (count updateActor per getSuggestions). Then batch into one write after the step closes, or record only on explicit selection.
findings.alternatives: Keep history in client memory per session.
findings.regressionTests: Unit test with a mock actor counting setFlag calls per getSuggestions (expect 0 or 1).
findings.foundryAcceptance: Count re-renders while paging a feat step.

findings.title: 69 unreachable modules (~10.7k SLOC) in seven clusters
findings.observed: Clusters: (1) scripts/engine/analysis/** dev/audit scripts - C (or move to tools/); (2) scripts/engine/suggestion/gm/** GM insight monitors - unwired, intent unknown (investigate); (3) ArchetypeAffinityEngine/ArchetypeEngineHooks/ArchetypeSuggestionIntegration/ArchetypeLoader/ArchetypeShiftTracker/ArchetypeEnhancedForceOptionSuggestionEngine/ArchetypeUIComponents/constants/archetype-bias-enums - superseded by ArchetypeRegistry SSOT, C; (4) legacy mentor suggestion stack (mentor-suggestion-engine, mentor-suggestion-data 2,279 SLOC, json-loader, two cloned MentorSuggestionDialog files, voice-filter/synthesizer, guidance, help-strings, topic-atoms, transitions, reflective-dialog/init, decision-logger x2, translation-settings/presets, dialogue-variants) - C, except mentor-personalities.js and mentor-conditional-variants.js which are test-only (B, see F-MEN-010); (5) engine/mentor orphans (interaction-orchestrator, synthesis-config, reason-renderer, selector, decision-logger, address-*, index) - C; (6) suggestion one-offs (tier1-standalone-simulation, character-data-analysis, scoring-walkthrough, equipment/{asset-suggestions,tactical-evaluator,armor-gear-scoring-engine,combat-engine,combat-hooks,report-schema}, MentorSystem, MentorWishlistIntegration, MentorClarificationSystem, EvidenceCardFactory, suggestion-advisory-formatter, suggestion-settings, validateClassArchetypes) - C; (7) scripts/infrastructure/hooks/suggestion-hooks.js + scripts/utils/verify-suggestions.js - unwired cache-invalidation hooks (caches are revision-keyed so not required; C after F-MEN-011). String-name matches (mentor-reason-renderer, translation-presets, mentor-guidance, gm-suggestion-panel) were checked and resolve to different files or CSS classes. No pack/macro references found.
findings.proposedSolution: Delete clusters 1,3,4,5,6 after a final grep of packs/macros; owner decides cluster 2; delete 7 together with F-MEN-011 fix.
findings.alternatives: Move cluster 1 to tools/ if still used manually.
findings.regressionTests: Full test suite; census reachability recount.
findings.foundryAcceptance: Smoke: open Mentor chat, survey, suggestions after deletion.
findings.simplificationBenefit: ~10.7k SLOC and two parallel archetype/mentor-suggestion paths removed.
findings.risk: Low; static proof of no runtime path for most.

findings.title: _buildIntentCache grows without bound
findings.observed: Keys include the actor revision hash, so entries are never stale, but nothing evicts old revisions (clearBuildIntentCache only called from orphan suggestion-hooks.js). SuggestionService's own cache is LRU-bounded.
findings.intendedOwnership: A-16: derived-only cache with explicit invalidation/bounds.
findings.proposedSolution: Add the same LRU bound as SuggestionService or drop old revisions for an actor on insert. Instrument map size in a long session first.
findings.regressionTests: Unit test: N revisions -> map size bounded.
